$comment: Effect status to candidate disposition. Kept as data, not Python literals, so this module holds no canonical schema enum value as a string literal (EF4-I22). The engine verifies at every use that the keys cover EffectStatus exactly, so a status added to the contract fails loudly here instead of falling through to a permissive default.

FAILED.reason: the effect was attempted and did not succeed

NOT_EXECUTED.reason: the effect never began, so the candidate leaves the pipeline unpersisted

ROLLED_BACK.reason: the effect was undone, so nothing it wrote may be counted as persisted

SUCCEEDED.reason: the effect landed and its result artifacts are recorded

UNKNOWN.reason: the runtime could not observe the outcome, so the candidate is neither persisted nor terminal until reconciliation resolves it
